title: amauropelta gracilis
intro: Amauropelta gracilis, commonly known as the Slender Rasp Fern or Graceful Fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Amauropilis gracilis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
